purpose: Generated runtime loading contract for app-owned node and Ask integration.
appLaneNote: Data contract only; app-owned code chooses fetch, cache, UI states, and error presentation.

integrityContract.validate: Use the sha256 value from manifest.json for each loaded node file when the runtime supports digest checks.
integrityContract.retry: On a hash mismatch or parse failure, refetch the file once before marking that stage unavailable.
integrityContract.fallback: Never fabricate results from a failed generated index; keep already-loaded stages usable.

stages.label: Bootstrap node metadata
stages.trigger: App startup, before node or Ask features claim generated-index coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Load metadata before generated node search or node pages are enabled.
Treat manifest.json as the file inventory and node-load-plan.json as the runtime sequence.
Do not block the first usable app view on lazy product or page-node indexes.
stages.failureMode: Keep existing app search/data paths usable and mark generated node features as unavailable if metadata cannot load.

stages.label: Keep established node primitives eager
stages.trigger: Startup, using the existing small node files already produced by other pipelines.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep tag, errand, and synonym node helpers available without waiting for full Ask.
If a helper file is absent, degrade only the dependent helper surface.
Do not infer missing tag, errand, or synonym coverage from generated brand/company data.
stages.failureMode: Disable the affected helper surface rather than fabricating labels or routes.

stages.label: Load compact Ask core for startup search
stages.trigger: Startup search box, command palette, or any first-use Ask entry point.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep ask-core.json under the startup budget with minimum headroom.
Use ask-core hash targets directly; do not require ask-index-*.json for category, brand, company, guide, line, tag, or errand results.
Preserve resolver ordering from the generated traces, including typo before loose containment.
stages.failureMode: Show a search-unavailable state or fall back to existing in-memory search; do not eagerly pull ask-index-*.json as a rescue path.

stages.label: Load the brand layer of Ask on the first keystroke
stages.trigger: First keystroke in a search box, or a submitted query, whichever comes first.
acceptanceCriteria: Merge ask-brands.json into the ask-core.json layer; the merged layer resolves exactly as the single core file did.
Keep ask-brands.json out of startup: catalogue growth adds brands here, not to the startup file.
If the brand layer fails, keep core results (categories, companies, guides, lines, tags, errands) visible.
stages.failureMode: Brand results can be missing while every other core result keeps working.

stages.label: Defer full brand and company page nodes
stages.trigger: First visit to a brand or company node page, ownership view, or flagship walkthrough that needs full node context.
acceptanceCriteria: Do not load brand/company page indexes before startup search is usable.
Use node page contracts to check required fields before rendering.
If the target node is unknown, render a not-covered state instead of a blank or fabricated page.
stages.failureMode: Brand/company node pages can be unavailable while category and guide routes remain usable.

stages.label: Lazy-load full product and barcode Ask
stages.trigger: Product-name search, barcode lookup, or an explicit deeper-results action.
acceptanceCriteria: Never require the full Ask index for the first usable search result list.
Load once and cache by manifest sha256 when a product/barcode path asks for it.
If the lazy index fails, keep core results visible and label product lookup as unavailable.
stages.failureMode: Product lookup can fail independently without breaking startup Ask or generated node pages.

stages.label: Use generated contracts for integration QA
stages.trigger: Development, preview QA, and H4 drain checks; not needed for normal runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: Run contract audits before claiming node/Ask integration complete.
Use positive route fixtures and guardrails together.
Keep H4 active until the app consumes these contracts or documents equivalent coverage.
stages.failureMode: A green build is not enough to drain H4 if the app has no matching integration behavior.
